# Requirements interview (fixture)

## Consumers

## The discipline

- Ask deep, non-obvious questions covering all aspects of the task.
- Avoid generic or superficial questions.
- **Scan the other open issues in the same breath.**
- **Single filter test**: does existing code misbehave, observably?
- **Two-tier fallback when reproduction fails**: ask the person, then proceed on a hypothesis.
- Iterate between interviewing and codebase exploration until the critical aspects are covered.

## What this file does not decide

Where the interview sits in the consuming skill's order.
